# Master Build Plan — 2026-05-19

## Vision
Build #1 FP&A desktop app defeating 25 competitors by 1000x.

## 3 Phases, 10 Features, 65 Hours

### Phase 1: Competitive Parity (27h)
1. **NLQ** (4h) — Natural Language Queries, 1000x impact
2. **3-Statement** (4h) — Integrated P&L+BS+CF
3. **Chart Integration** (4h) — Wire 6 charts to pages
4. **Virtual Scrolling** (2h) — DataTable for 1000+ rows
5. **Rolling/Driver/WhatIf UI** (7h) — Wire existing engines
6. **Template Library** (8h) — 16 industry templates

### Phase 2: Enterprise (16h)
7. **NLQ Chat** (4h) — Chat-based financial queries
8. **Zero-Based Budgeting** (4h) — Build from zero
9. **ERP Connectors** (16h) — QuickBooks/NetSuite/Salesforce

### Phase 3: Polish (8h)
10. **Chart Export/Drill-down** (4h) — PNG/SVG, click-through
11. **Performance** (2h) — Lazy loading, memoization
12. **Template Customization** (2h) — Modify before applying

## 9 Unique Moats
1. Offline-first (Tauri + IndexedDB)
2. Desktop app (native speed)
3. One-time price ($0 vs $50K+/yr)
4. 232 engines (4.6x Anaplan)
5. Plugin system (extensible)
6. WCAG 2.1 AA (accessibility)
7. 16 sectors (3x Anaplan)
8. Keyboard shortcuts (full system)
9. ESG reporting (built-in)
